# PP: written by `uv run ppc disasters apply` (src/prosper_or_perish_constructor/disaster_growing_pain.py); do not edit.
decline_of_empire = {

	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/decline_of_empire.dds"
	
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_low

	can_start = {
		pp_disaster_restart_allowed_trigger = { type = decline_of_empire } # PP: growing pain

		# Empire-tier crisis: only fully established empires, and only from the Age of Discovery onward.
		# The empire-rank gate was dropped when this disaster was repurposed around Complacency; with
		# Complacency removed, restoring it (plus lifting the age floor past the Renaissance) stops the
		# disaster over-triggering on small early-game realms.
		country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
		NOR = {
			current_age = age_1_traditions
			current_age = age_2_renaissance
		}
		has_any_active_disaster = no
		stability < 0
		is_subject = no
		OR = {
			switch = {
				trigger = current_age
				age_3_discovery = { average_control_in_home_region < 0.45 }
				age_4_reformation = { average_control_in_home_region < 0.5 }
				age_5_absolutism = { average_control_in_home_region < 0.55 }
				age_6_revolutions = { average_control_in_home_region < 0.6 }
			}
			total_not_tolerated_culture_population > {
				value = total_population
				divide = 3
			}
		}

		custom_tooltip = { 
			text = has_not_had_decline_of_empire_last_25_years 
			NOT = { has_variable = had_doe_disaster_variable }
		}

		custom_tooltip = {
			text = not_recently_become_empire_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = recently_became_empire_variable }
		}
	}
	
	can_end = { # PP: growing pain: vanilla's way out, or from 50 years the same with less stability
		OR = {
			AND = {
		decline_of_empire_end_trigger = yes
	}
			AND = {
				pp_disaster_relief_due_trigger = { type = decline_of_empire }
				pp_disaster_relief_decline_of_empire_trigger = yes
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		global_estate_target_satisfaction = larger_permanent_target_satisfaction_penalty
		monthly_rebel_growth = 0.003
		bank_interest = 0.05
		global_manpower_modifier = -0.3
		regiment_recruit_speed = -0.3
		discipline = -0.10
		land_morale_modifier = -0.10
		global_institution_growth_modifier = -0.5
		global_mercenaries_modifier = -0.5
		monthly_prestige = -0.5
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.3
		country_cabinet_efficiency = -0.2
		research_speed_modifier = -0.5
	}
	
	on_start = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = decline_of_empire.1 
		set_variable = {	#Declares the target control in home region for the trigger
			name = average_control_in_home_region_target_variable
			value = {
				add = average_control_in_home_region
				multiply = 1.2
				min = 0.5
				max = 0.8
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = ai_stability_target_decline_of_empire
			years = -1
			mode = add_and_extend
		}
	}
	on_end = {
		# PP: growing pain: ended by the relaxed branch: no restart for a while
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { AND = {
		decline_of_empire_end_trigger = yes
	} } }
			pp_disaster_restart_block_effect = { type = decline_of_empire }
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_doe_disaster_variable
			years = 25 
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = decline_of_empire.2
		remove_country_modifier = ai_stability_target_decline_of_empire
		# PP: growing pain
		pp_disaster_pain_clear_effect = { type = decline_of_empire }
	}
	
	on_monthly = {
		random_list = {
			5 = { custom_tooltip = an_event_occurs_tt }
			95 = { custom_tooltip = no_event_occurs_tt }
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			random_list = {
				96 = { }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = decline_of_empire.3 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = decline_of_empire.4 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = decline_of_empire.6 }
				1 = { trigger_event_silently = decline_of_empire.9 }
			}

			random_list = {
				95 = { }
				5 = {
					trigger = {
						any_neighbor_country = {
							NOT = { has_casus_belli_on = root }
							NOT = { any_active_disaster = { disaster_type = disaster_type:decline_of_empire } }
							at_war = no
							is_during_bankruptcy = no
							NOR = {
								in_union_with = root
								has_mutual_scripted_relation = {
									type = relation_type:alliance
									target = root
								}
								has_truce_with = root
								is_at_war_with = root
								is_fighting_war_together_with = root
								ROOT = { is_subject_of = prev }
							}
						}
					}
					random_neighbor_country = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { any_active_disaster = { disaster_type = disaster_type:decline_of_empire } }
							at_war = no
							is_during_bankruptcy = no
							can_declare_war_on = root
							NOR = {
								in_union_with = root
								has_mutual_scripted_relation = {
									type = relation_type:alliance
									target = root
								}
								has_truce_with = root
								is_at_war_with = root
								is_fighting_war_together_with = root
								ROOT = { is_subject_of = prev }
							}
						}
						trigger_event_silently = decline_of_empire.5
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# PP: growing pain
		pp_disaster_pain_effect = { type = decline_of_empire }
		pp_disaster_relief_notice_effect = { type = decline_of_empire }
	}
}
